title: Gini impurity and the best split
summary: Gini impurity and the best decision tree split over all features, with midpoint thresholds, weighted child impurity and a fixed tie rule.

mutants.feature_axis_rows: Loops over X.shape[0], the number of rows, and not over the features.
mutants.gini_empty_one: Has no rule for an empty set, so the impurity of no labels is 1.0 and not 0.0.
mutants.threshold_at_value: Uses the lower unique value as the threshold and not the midpoint.
mutants.tie_last_wins: Replaces the best threshold on an equal impurity, so the last tied threshold wins.
mutants.unweighted_children: Takes the plain mean of the two child impurities and does not weight by size.
